2. **Missing thread, short notice** — `https://www.chiphell.com/forum.php?mod=viewthread&tid=1`  
   Body is “抱歉，指定的主题不存在或已被删除或正在被审核” plus footer. Not a captcha page. [[2]](https://www.chiphell.com/forum.php?mod=viewthread&tid=1)

3. **Empty fetches (not a captcha page either)** — `forum.php?mod=viewthread&tid=2509145` and `tid=1041179` returned no extractable content in this session. Same pattern on the pretty URL `thread-2509145-1-1.html`. No captcha markup was present in what came back. [[3]](https://www.chiphell.com/forum.php?mod=viewthread&tid=2509145) [[4]](https://www.chiphell.com/forum.php?mod=viewthread&tid=1041179)

4. **Rewrite target is `viewthread`** — Discuz rewrite maps `thread-{tid}-…html` to `forum.php?mod=viewthread&tid=…` (shown in an old Chiphell rewrite thread). [[5]](https://www.chiphell.com/thread-1041179-1-1.html)

5. **Same thread via search index** — Indexed copy of tid 2438513 is ordinary post text, not a verification interstitial. [[6]](https://www.chiphell.com/forum.php?action=printable&mod=viewthread&tid=2438513)

6. **Forum lists load as normal Discuz** — `forum.php?mod=forumdisplay` (e.g. fid 146) returns board lists, not a captcha shell. [[7]](https://www.chiphell.com/forum.php?mod=forumdisplay&fid=146&orderby=lastpost&filter=dateline&dateline=604800&typeid=997)

7. **Home/community index** — `forum.php` community page is standard section lists and stats. [[8]](https://www.chiphell.com/forum.php?mod=&mobile=no)

8. **Related, not this page** — Users discuss occasional “请求已被站点的安全策略拦截” (described as outside/Tencent-side blocking), separate from the `viewthread` HTML when the thread renders. [[9]](https://www.chiphell.com/thread-2844250-1-1.html)
